doc_friction.issue: The README's rebuild steps for web/cyclehound.wasm need the wasm32-unknown-unknown target, which this cloud container lacks; it fails inside crossbeam-utils with no hint. Harmless here because the wasm surface was not changed.
/usr/bin/time is not installed in the container; measure.py is the working substitute. A pointer to it from the opinion piece's 'measure the original first' step would save a failed attempt.

deviations.why: Only ts-unused-exports was measured, not knip: knip needs per-project entry configuration to run on a tree of 1,300 ventures.
deviations.result: The comparison is against one reference tool; knip is left for a later run.

notes: Explore idea: unused-exports detection in the Rust cyclehound (the 'dev tools in Rust' direction; knip/ts-unused-exports' job). Measured on 11,736 ventures .mjs files: ts-unused-exports 11.0.1 10.7-11.4 s / 368-390 MB vs cyclehound 0.31-0.33 s / 29-30 MB; 5,419 shared findings; all 854 differences classified (527 whole-module dynamic imports by design, 252 ts-unused-exports false positives on destructured dynamic imports, 37 later declarators/destructuring and 10 export* chain names ts-unused-exports misses, rest fixture/spelling). Local checks: cargo test 18 pass, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean, node tests 15 pass, post front matter/link checks clean. Next: tsconfig paths aliases, then a CI gate.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design and implement an export/usage pass with re-export propagation, tests, a benchmark against a reference tool and classification of ~850 differences, docs and post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
